download_directory: download a remote gcloud storage directory to a local path using rsync
download_physics_iq_data: download the Physics-IQ dataset for a specified FPS value between 1 and 30
run_download_8fps: run the download script with 8 FPS to get pre-computed 8 FPS videos
run_download_16fps: run the download script with 16 FPS to get pre-computed 16 FPS videos
run_download_12fps: run the download script with 12 FPS to download 30 FPS and locally downsample to 12 FPS
